# Roman Muse Town

Roman Muse Town is a small Roman district you keep with a companion named Aelia. You walk as a centurion, visit the forum, the Colosseum, the market, the baths, the lake and the forest, water a Town Tree that grows by real days, and follow quests and festivals. Aelia keeps a notebook, writes letters, tracks your real projects as Roman quests on a notice board, and notices heavy days. The town is scripted by default, with an optional model-backed live chat. Every new town starts fresh, from its own person's life, never copied from the original town.
